mentions.name: Claude Code session reconstruction CLI
mentions.description: This CLI tool reconstructs Claude Code coding sessions interval by interval, showing what was asked of the agent and what it actually ended up doing, with the ability to do a deep dive where needed. It targets the pain of reviewing unattended or older sessions across scrolling, jsonl grepping, session replays, and git diffs, as well as multiple sessions coordinating agents on the same repository.
mentions.problem: Developers using Claude Code, particularly the author for personal use
mentions.audience: With unattended Claude Code sessions or work done a while ago, it is difficult and time-consuming to reconstruct what was asked of Claude Code and what it actually did, including reviewing git diffs and handling multiple sessions coordinating their own agents on the same repository.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I'm working on a CLI tool that helps me reconstruct this interval by interval, and then do a deep dive where needed. So far it has been quite interesting - it is teaching me a lot about how the Claude Code harness works.
mentions.author: jagmeetchawla
